changelog: Titles now come with a cover and a short hook clip you can post.

en.description: Turn a product, an account, or posts you paste into title options and a topic list grounded in what people are already publishing. This title and topic workflow reads public posts on Douyin, Xiaohongshu, TikTok, and X when you want a live read, then writes hooks and titles you can shoot today. Use it for trend titles, topic selection, and the next post on an existing account.
en.summary: Titles and a topic list from pasted posts or a live public read.
en.title: Viral Titles and Topics

ja.display_name: バズるタイトルと企画

zh.description: 把商品、账号或你贴来的帖子做成爆款标题与选题。爆款标题给出可直接用的标题开头，选题按今天能拍的角度分组。需要看别人正在发什么时，读取抖音、小红书、TikTok 和 X 的公开热帖，再写你的标题。适合已有账号的下一篇，也适合从一个卖点起一组标题。
zh.summary: 从你贴来的帖子或一次公开热帖读取里，写出标题和今天能拍的选题。
zh.title: 爆款标题与选题
